backend/main.mo: Defines the backend actor with access control, citizen onboarding, user profiles, work log management, and DAO proposal structures and state.
feature_evidence.json: Describes a feature report for updating transfer and balance APIs, listing affected frontend files and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten one‑sentence summaries for various frontend files including styles, hooks, components, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication flow, loading states, profile setup, and dashboard rendering.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal for first‑time users to submit their display name and complete profile setup.
frontend/src/components/contributions/Co: UI container with tabs for viewing and creating work logs.
frontend/src/components/contributions/Wo: Form for submitting new work logs with category selection, description, and timestamp inputs.
Displays and sorts work logs, showing details, verification status, and a button for non‑owners to validate logs.
frontend/src/components/governance/Gover: Provides a tabbed interface for viewing existing proposals or creating new ones in the governance system.
frontend/src/components/governance/Propo: Form for submitting a new governance proposal with title, description, budget, and autogenerated start time.
Fetches and lists proposals with phase indicators, budget, countdowns, and vote breakdowns.
Layout wrapper providing header, footer, and branding around all app pages.
frontend/src/components/profile/UserProf: Shows the user's profile, principal, and citizen ID status with onboarding controls.
frontend/src/components/wallet/TokenWall: Displays token balance and provides a validated form for transferring SUZHI tokens to another principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Initializes and caches a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Fetches the caller's user profile using the actor, handling loading state tied to identity readiness.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context for Internet Identity login, identity management, and AuthClient initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for citizen onboarding, balances, transfers, and work log retrieval using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind styles and theme variables for light and dark modes with earthy color palettes.
frontend/src/lib/governance.ts: Contains helpers to determine proposal phases and compute countdown text based on start timestamps.
frontend/src/lib/workLog.ts: Provides label mappings and formatting helpers for work log categories, status, and time spent.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider and renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the main dashboard with tabbed sections for profile, wallet, contributions, and governance.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters, including hash routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode, custom earthy color palette, extended typography, animations, shadows, and container settings for the frontend UI.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s high-level dApp state, architecture notes, issues, and existing feature implementations for the SUZHI ICP ecosystem.
